problem: Project tooling can drift into bespoke infrastructure, ambiguous vendor claims, unlocked helper dependency graphs, or editor tooling that leaks into shipping runtime.
invariant: Evaluate proven public patterns/reviewed tools, then platform-native capability, then proven OSS/DCC, then minimal custom tooling; keep exact provenance and dependency locks, prefer bounded domain operations, and exclude dev/editor/proof tools from shipping by default.
evidence: ue-mcp exact upstream revision + lockfile + reproducible install drift guard
do_not_copy: SkyHook or embark-claude-index as required dependencies
YACS Unreal paths, route names or proof workflow identifiers
failure_behavior: Fail closed when a declared authoritative tool lacks its repository return path/provenance/lock/lifecycle boundary or when a dev/editor-only contract drifts into shipping.
